decision: Select the previously validated compact hybrid as the main model.
decision_evidence: Two development partitions, three seeds each; repair remains behind compact.
model: SPARC-CS2: frozen structured neural + risk boosting + SITE + public rules/deadline projection
fit_scope: The original main 30 training series only. No development or test refit.
trained_weights: Reuse the existing main checkpoints listed below, without additional fitting.
constants: Use the original training-fitted support/main/fit.json and source geometry.
validation_gate: Reproduce the existing main development results and aligned per-cutoff values before external inference.
test_scope: Every eligible round from every original portable index entry with role=test (Rio).
exclusion: Use the pre-existing scoring_eligibility and frame_indices unchanged. Record exclusions.
endpoint: Next first event within 20 one-second bins over 511 nonempty simultaneous mark sets, plus no-event tail.
primary: Joint negative log likelihood, cutoff mean within round, round mean within series, equal series mean; mean of three seed scores.
secondary: A/B first-ingress probability Brier at 10 seconds
conditional A/B destination log loss at the observed event bin
per-series differences and event-deduplicated destination scores
ablation_semantics: Frozen-component deletion and matched spatial-permutation control; do not label these as end-to-end retraining.
uncertainty: Paired bootstrap over series after averaging seed differences; 10000 draws; report counts and intervals.
no_test_selection: No threshold, checkpoint, mixture, model, split or exclusion changes based on Rio scores. Retain all defined references and endpoints.
reporting: A positive result supports the evaluated task and cohort; it is not an acceptance guarantee or proof of universal generalization.
